newsitem.title: USA: Prime Hospitality to open up to 100 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Prime Hospitality to open up to 100 hotels.

text.p: Prime Hospitality Corp said on Tuesday that it plans to build and open up to 100 new hotels by 1998.
The company said 14 AmeriSuites were opened in 1996 and up to 30 newly constructed hotels are planned for 1997.
Prime Hospitality currently started construction on a five-story, 124-suite AmeriSuites hotel at a site in Princeton, New Jersey.
The construction by Damon Douglas Construction of Cranford, New Jersey, is expected to be completed by October 1997, the company said.
